title: Classification Algorithms
description: Modul mendalam algoritma klasifikasi: Logistic Regression, Sigmoid, Decision Boundary, Multiclass (OvR/Multinomial Softmax), Teorema Bayes & Naive Bayes (Gaussian, Multinomial, Bernoulli), matriks konfusi (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Specificity, F1), kalibrasi threshold, analisis ROC-AUC & PR-AUC, serta mitigasi class imbalance.
objectives: Menjelaskan konsep Classification dalam Supervised Learning.
Membedakan binary, multiclass, dan multilabel classification.
Menjelaskan Logistic Regression dan fungsi sigmoid.
Menginterpretasikan odds ratio dan decision boundary.
Menjelaskan teorema Bayes dan Naive Bayes.
Membedakan Gaussian, Multinomial, dan Bernoulli Naive Bayes.
Menghitung Confusion Matrix: TP, TN, FP, FN.
Menghitung dan menginterpretasikan Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Specificity, dan F1-Score.
Menjelaskan threshold calibration dan trade-off Precision-Recall.
Mengevaluasi class imbalance dan strategi penanganannya.
Mengevaluasi generalisasi dan keterbatasan model classification.

references.title: Géron, A. (2022). Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow (3rd ed.)
Hastie, T., Tibshirani, R., & Friedman, J. (2009). The Elements of Statistical Learning (2nd ed.)
Murphy, K. P. (2022). Probabilistic Machine Learning: An Introduction
Russell, S., & Norvig, P. (2020). Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach (4th ed.)
